sources.title: Leadership Sync
sources.text: Arjun: Let's keep this quick. Neha, where are we on the Q3 campaign deck? Neha: Draft is 80% done. I'll send it to Arjun for review by Wednesday. Arjun: Good. Also, remind me — I told Raghav I'd send him the updated vendor list. I'll get that to him by end of day tomorrow. Raghav: Appreciated. Separately, the Mumbai office renewal paperwork needs someone to sign off this week. Not sure whose desk that's on right now. Divya: I think that's supposed to be Facilities, but I haven't seen anyone pick it up. Arjun: Okay, flag it, don't assume. Divya, can you also pull the July expense variance report before Thursday's board prep? Divya: Yes, I'll have it ready Wednesday evening. Arjun: One more thing — client call with Meridian Logistics got pushed. I need to reconfirm the new time with their team myself. Neha: Also, just a reminder, the campaign deck review — I said Wednesday, but realistically Thursday morning is safer. Arjun: Noted.

sources.title: Vendor List
sources.text: Raghav: Following up from the sync — can you send the updated vendor list today? Arjun: Running behind, will send first thing tomorrow morning instead. Raghav: No worries, whenever you get a chance today works. Arjun: Sorry, got pulled into board prep — will send by tomorrow (Wednesday) morning for sure. Raghav: Just checking — still good for this morning?

sources.title: Q3 Campaign Deck
sources.text: Neha: Deck's coming together, still targeting Wednesday for your review. Neha: Heads up — shifting the review to Thursday morning instead of Wednesday, need one more day on the data slides. Arjun: Understood, Thursday morning works. What time exactly? Neha: Let's say 9:30 AM Thursday, before your board prep block. Neha: Deck is ready, attaching the draft ahead of our 9:30 review.

sources.title: Call Reschedule
sources.text: Priya: Our scheduled call this week got bumped from our side — can you propose a new time? We're flexible Tuesday–Thursday afternoons. Arjun: Apologies for the delay — how about Wednesday 3:00 PM? Priya: Wednesday 3 PM works on our end, confirmed. Priya: Quick check — still on for 3 PM today? Arjun: Yes, confirmed, see you at 3.

sources.title: Expense Variance Report
sources.text: Divya: Starting on the July variance numbers, targeting Thursday morning for board prep as discussed. Arjun: Actually, can I get it by Wednesday evening instead? Want time to review before Thursday. Divya: Wednesday evening is tight but doable, I'll prioritize it. Divya: Report attached, sent as promised. Arjun: Got it, thank you — exactly what I needed before tomorrow.

sources.title: Mumbai Office Lease Renewal
sources.text: Facilities: Reminder: the Mumbai office lease renewal requires an authorized signature by Friday, 25 September. Raghav: Following up from the sync — has anyone confirmed who's signing off on the Mumbai renewal? Don't think it's been assigned. Divya: Not on my end — I believe this typically sits with Facilities directly, not us. Facilities: Second reminder: signature is still pending. Deadline is Friday, 25 September, end of day. Raghav: This is now one day out and still unowned — can you confirm who's handling it?

sources.title: Voice Note 1
sources.text: Quick note to self — need to get Raghav that vendor list, I think I said today but it might slip to tomorrow morning, remind me. Also still haven't heard back on the Mumbai lease thing, someone needs to own that, I don't think it's me.

sources.title: Voice Note 2
sources.text: Reminder — expense variance report from Divya needs to be in my hands by Wednesday evening, not Thursday, I want time to go through it before board prep. Also Meridian call — I owe Priya a time, need to lock that in today.
